Practitioner-Led Healthcare Dining

Why I Built ShorelineOps Inside a Real Senior Living Kitchen.

"Nobody selling healthcare dietary software has ever cooked a pureed dinner service for 80 residents with 14 different allergy restrictions while balancing food cost."

If you have ever stepped into a senior living dietary department at 4:30 PM, you know the daily high-stakes reality:

The Daily 4:30 PM Rush
  • 1. Last-Minute Clinical Changes: Nursing calls down right before tray line with two room transfers, a new physician Low Sodium diet order, and a resident newly designated NPO awaiting swallow evaluation.
  • 2. Kitchen Ergonomics Under Fire: Line cooks with wet nitrile gloves are trying to read faded handwriting on a greasy whiteboard while staging 4 pans of hot entrees.
  • 3. Clipboard Inventory Guesswork: Building weekly orders for Dennis Food Service or Sysco using clipboards and guesswork, hoping you don't stock out of thickener or pureed meats before Friday truck delivery.

The Legacy Industry Dilemma

When I looked across the commercial software landscape, I found two deeply frustrating options:

1. Proprietary Monopolies ($1,200+/mo)

Bulky software designed for 500-bed hospital chains, bloated with unnecessary complexity, requiring 6 months of onboarding, and locking you into a single distributor.

2. Paper Binders & Spreadsheets

What most independent and assisted living homes actually use because commercial software is unaffordable, resulting in human error and survey anxiety.

The ShorelineOps Vision: Open Core + Clinical Precision

I built ShorelineOps to be the tool I needed in the kitchen every single morning:

  • 100% Free Open-Source Core: Any independent care home, hospice, or non-profit assisted living community can run our software completely free. Clinical safety should never be paywalled.
  • Big, High-Contrast Touch Targets (44px+): Touch tablet kiosk mode designed specifically for gloved line cooks to tap easily during hot line service.
  • IDDSI 2.0 Hard-Blocks: Strict clinical safety rules preventing a Regular texture plate from ever being served to an IDDSI Level 4 Pureed resident.
  • Algorithmic Split MRP Purchasing: Automatically compares line-item contract quotes across Dennis Food Service, Sysco, and US Foods, awarding each line to the lowest-cost vendor.

Let’s Talk Culinary & Dietary Operations

Whether you are a Dietary Manager in New England or an Executive Director looking to tighten food spend and survey readiness, we would love to show you ShorelineOps.
